capabilities: Log workouts with sets, RPE and duration
Compute daily readiness from sleep, HRV and training load
Generate training and nutrition recommendations with cited sources
Build weekly plans, programs and goals
Import runs from Garmin Connect, Strava, Runna and GPX/TCX/FIT files
disambiguation: Not a form-building tool; 'form' here means physical fitness — it is a workout, recovery and nutrition log.
extras: Not a medical app; nutrition equations accurate to roughly ±10%. A detailed testing status lists features only covered by automated tests or previews. Interface in English and Czech; passed the directory's automated checks but was not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to log workouts, derive readiness from sleep and HRV, or produce training and nutrition advice while keeping everything in plain Markdown notes.
